articles.author: Sarah Perez
articles.title: Buried in Meta’s $18B settlement is a legal pass on kids’ data - TechCrunch
articles.description: Meta’s settlement with 29 states allows it to retain certain data from children under 13 to train and test age-detection models, highlighting a privacy trade-off built into the deal.
